title: John Alexander's paranormal research in 92 countries, including Mongolia

tellings.quote: and he's been to 90 92 countries >> doing um research into everything from churches to ceremonies in Mongolia the reindeer herders

plain: A researcher named John B. Alexander has travelled to some 90 or 92 countries studying the paranormal, according to Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs. Bledsoe tells Michels that Alexander's research ranged "from churches to ceremonies in Mongolia," among the reindeer herders there, which paints him as someone who has looked for strange experiences all over the world.
